   "source": [
    "# Multicell wakefield under uncertainty\n",
    "\n",
    "> Uncertainty quantification plugs into every analysis. Add a `uq_config` and the\n",
    "> analysis is evaluated over a quadrature of the uncertain geometry, returning a\n",
    "> distribution (mean, standard deviation) instead of a single number.\n",
    "\n",
    "The [simplecell wakefield-UQ example](../advanced/wakefield_uq.ipynb) perturbs a cavity's\n",
    "mid/end-cell parameter *groups*. Multicell UQ\n",
    "(`uq_config['cell_complexity'] = 'multicell'`) goes finer: every half-cell becomes an\n",
    "independent random variable, subject to the equator/iris continuity constraints — the same\n",
    "parameterisation the [eigenmode multicell UQ/SA example](../eigenmode/multicell_uq_sa.ipynb)\n",
    "uses, now driving the ABCI wakefield solve.\n",
    "\n",
    "The ABCI backend needs no special handling: the deck is written from the cavity's\n",
    "`profile()`, which already renders an independently-varying multicell contour, so each\n",
    "perturbed variant produces a correct deck automatically."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "5b629b1c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-21T09:48:02.612888Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-21T09:48:02.612751Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.190052Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.189364Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "from cavsim2d import Study, EllipticalCavity\n",
    "from cavsim2d.utils.style import apply_style\n",
    "\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "apply_style()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f9afdbdc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. A two-cell cavity and its uncertainty\n",
    "\n",
    "A two-cell TESLA-like cavity. We put a manufacturing tolerance on the equator radius\n",
    "`Req`. `delta` is an additive perturbation in millimetres (not a fraction), so\n",
    "`delta=[0.3]` is a realistic ±0.3 mm equator tolerance — a perturbation much smaller\n",
    "than this leaves the impedance unchanged to the solver's numerical resolution.\n",
    "\n",
    "Under `cell_complexity='multicell'` the shared entries collapse to one random variable\n",
    "each — `Req` is shared by a cell's two halves, so a two-cell cavity has two\n",
    "independent `Req` random variables (one per cell). UQ runs through `Study`, not a bare\n",
    "`Cavity`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "101c21b9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.192164Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.191905Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.204993Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.203998Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "cavs = Study(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'mc_wake_uq'))\n",
    "mid = [42, 42, 12, 19, 35, 57.7, 103.353]\n",
    "cavs.add_cavity([EllipticalCavity(2, mid, mid, mid, beampipe='both')], ['W'])\n",
    "\n",
    "config = {\n",
    "    'MROT': 2, 'wakelength': 5, 'bunch_length': 25, 'processes': 1,\n",
    "    'uq_config': {\n",
    "        'variables': ['Req'],\n",
    "        'delta': [0.3],                         # +/- 0.3 mm equator tolerance (additive, mm)\n",
    "        'objectives': [['min', 'ZL', [0.2, 2.0, 5.0]],\n",
    "                       ['min', 'ZT', [0.2, 2.0, 5.0]]],\n",
    "        'method': ['Quadrature', 'Stroud3'],\n",
    "        'cell_complexity': 'multicell',\n",
    "        'processes': 1,\n",
    "    },\n",
    "}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "af7f38ab",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Run it\n",
    "\n",
    "Every quadrature node is a full ABCI wakefield solve on a perturbed multicell geometry,\n",
    "so this is the slowest of the UQ examples. `MROT=2` asks for both the longitudinal\n",
    "(`ZL`) and transverse (`ZT`) impedance; the objectives read the peak `|Z|` in each\n",
    "frequency window (in GHz — a flat `[lo, mid, hi]` list defines the windows\n",
    "`lo<f<mid` and `mid<f<hi`)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "005f7a90",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.207396Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-21T09:48:04.207257Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-21T10:04:17.945315Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-21T10:04:17.944443Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "windows: ['ZL [max(0.2<f<2.0)]', 'ZL [max(2.0<f<5.0)]', 'ZT [max(0.2<f<2.0)]', 'ZT [max(2.0<f<5.0)]']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cavs.run_wakefield(config)\n",
    "uq = cavs.uq_hom_results['W']\n",
    "print('windows:', list(uq))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "02c6bc3f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. The impedance spread\n",
    "\n",
    "For each window the result carries the mean (`expe`) and standard deviation\n",
    "(`stdDev`) of the peak impedance across the perturbed multicell geometries — the spread\n",
    "the per-cell equator tolerance induces."
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    w: {'mean [Ohm(/m)]': v['expe'][0], 'std [Ohm(/m)]': v['stdDev'][0]}\n",
    "    for w, v in uq.items()\n",
    "}).T\n",
    "df.round(3)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8ecc0073",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. Mean with its uncertainty band\n",
    "\n",
    "`plot_hom_scatter(uq=True)` draws all four windows — longitudinal and transverse — each\n",
    "mean as a point with its tolerance-induced ±1σ error bar."
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "The `std` columns are the headline: a per-cell equator-radius tolerance of a few tenths\n",
    "of a millimetre already moves the higher-order-mode impedance by a measurable amount.\n",
    "\n",
    "See also: the [simplecell wakefield UQ](../advanced/wakefield_uq.ipynb) (mid/end-cell\n",
    "groups) and the [eigenmode multicell UQ/SA](../eigenmode/multicell_uq_sa.ipynb) (the same\n",
    "independent-half-cell parameterisation, with a Sobol sensitivity analysis)."
   ]
